name: AXIATA
recent: Axiata 在 2026 年 11 月宣布多项 edotco 资产处置交易，包括出售 edotco Holdings (Labuan)、edotco Towers Pakistan 及 edotco Group 约 15.645% 股权等。同期，公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩报告，并有多项 EPF 持股变动申报。
notable: 拟出售 edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited 全部股权给 OCK SEA TOWERS PTE. LTD.，以现金支付。
拟出售 edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited 全部股权给 Osiris Global Limited，以现金支付。
拟出售 edotco Group 约 15.645% 股权及 edotco Towers, Inc.、PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia、edotco Bangladesh Co. Ltd. 等资产。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 MYR 2,870.3 百万，环比增长 2.5%，同比下跌 3.2%；净利为 MYR 42.5 百万，环比下跌 84.5%，同比下跌 84.3%；净利率为 1.5%，低于上一季度的 9.8%。

recent_en: In November 2026, Axiata announced several edotco asset disposal transactions, including the disposal of edotco Holdings (Labuan), edotco Towers Pakistan, and approximately 15.645% equity interest in edotco Group. During the same period, the company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, alongside multiple EPF shareholding change filings.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of entire equity interest in edotco Holdings (Labuan) Limited to OCK SEA TOWERS PTE. LTD., satisfied entirely in cash.
Proposed disposal of entire equity interest in edotco Towers Pakistan (Private) Limited to Osiris Global Limited, satisfied entirely in cash.
Proposed disposal of approximately 15.645% equity interest in edotco Group and assets including edotco Towers, Inc., PT edotco Infrastruktur Indonesia, and edotco Bangladesh Co. Ltd.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was MYR 2,870.3 million, up 2.5% QoQ but down 3.2% YoY; net income was MYR 42.5 million, down 84.5% QoQ and 84.3% YoY; net margin was 1.5%, lower than 9.8% in the previous quarter.
